definitions.explanation: A person who provides aid, assistance, or support to others. Used in contexts ranging from international humanitarian aid to personal help and social welfare.

examples.japanese: {援助者|えんじょしゃ}が{現地|げんち}に{到着|とうちゃく}した。
examples.english: The aid workers arrived at the site.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{長年|ながねん}にわたって{難民|なんみん}の{援助者|えんじょしゃ}として{活動|かつどう}してきた。
examples.english: She has been working as an aid worker for refugees for many years.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}{被災地|ひさいち}には{多|おお}くの{援助者|えんじょしゃ}が{駆|か}けつけ、{食料|しょくりょう}や{物資|ぶっし}の{配布|はいふ}に{当|あ}たった。
examples.english: Many aid workers rushed to the disaster-affected area and took charge of distributing food and supplies.

notes:
Composed of {援助|えんじょ} (aid; assistance) and {者|しゃ} (person). Follows the common pattern of noun + {者|しゃ} to indicate the person who performs or embodies the action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {援助者|えんじょしゃ}として{活動|かつどう}する: to work as an aid provider
- {援助者|えんじょしゃ}を{派遣|はけん}する: to dispatch aid workers
- {国際|こくさい}{援助者|えんじょしゃ}: international aid worker

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {支援者|しえんしゃ}: supporter — slightly broader; often used for political or organizational backing
- ボランティア: volunteer — unpaid helper, not necessarily in the context of formal aid
- {救援者|きゅうえんしゃ}: rescuer; relief worker — emphasizes emergency rescue
- {後援者|こうえんしゃ}: patron; sponsor — financial or organizational backer
